rationale.overall: B’s stronger surface contrast and grounding read slightly closer to the reference’s photographic depth.
rationale.material: B gives the textured ground and surrounding shadows marginally more tactile dimensionality.
rationale.silhouette: The main block, loop, and icon boundary shapes appear effectively identical in both takes.
rationale.smallsize: Both takes reduce to the same clear dark-bar, pale-loop, and orange-edge read at small sizes.
